title: [master][Gen. Jnl.-Post Line]` Add var NextEntryNo, var NextVATEntryNo, and var NextTransactionNo to OnAfterInitGLRegister in StartPosting
summary: Three new variables (NextEntryNo, NextVATEntryNo, NextTransactionNo) are added as parameters to the OnAfterInitGLRegister event in the Gen. Jnl.-Post Line codeunit, allowing subscribers to access and modify these entry numbers during GL register initialization.
key_points: OnAfterInitGLRegister event now exposes NextEntryNo, NextVATEntryNo, and NextTransactionNo variables
Subscribers can read and modify entry number variables before GL register completion
Change applied consistently across all localization layers
Enables extensions to customize entry numbering behavior
